gen-dafont-groovy-gf-yaldevi: Yaldevi is a sans with an e that opens wide to the right. Groovy nearly seals its c shut and its strokes never swell or thin, so the open letters of Yaldevi supply the tension.
gen-dafont-horizon-fs-karma: A tube-like stroke that looks like neon glass gives Horizon its tall, nearly closed, striking presence up top. Horizon grabs attention while Karma, quietly modulated, never snags the eye.
gen-dafont-horizon-fs-paquito: Paquito is a confident, approachable serif whose lowercase nearly reaches the caps. Horizon makes the statement, its neon-tube strokes holding one width, while Paquito is happiest carrying a few sentences.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-abeezee: Each Impact Label letter sits alone, like a bead on a rod, heavy and commanding. ABeeZee comes in with a high mean line and terminals that stop short of the stem, giving those heavy beads room.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-aldrich: Impact Label is heavy and commanding, each letter standing alone. Its job is the punch, while Aldrich, a sans-serif with cupped round letters, does the tracing, one thick thread at a time.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-amiko: Heavy and commanding, Impact Label sets each letter apart, like a bead on a rod. And Amiko, with tall crayon-thick lowercase and outward-pointing terminals, would carry paragraphs smoothly, never tiring the eye.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-bangla: Anek Bangla brings wide, barely curled s curves and a short reach from midline to ascender beneath Impact Label. Modest sizing for the body lets the heavy heading dominate.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-devanaga: Impact Label hits hard, its beaded letters and pincer-like c making the statement. But Anek Devanagari, a sans-serif with distinctly open mouths and a tall middle zone, is the one built to carry the text.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-gujarati: Commanding and heavy, Impact Label stands each letter apart like beads on a rod. Anek Gujarati does the quiet job, its lowercase rivaling the capitals and its c gaping open.
gen-dafont-impact-label-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Heavy beads on a rod: Impact Label sets each letter alone, with a high-set x-height guide. Anek Gurmukhi offers big counters and open-handed curves everywhere, easing that weight.
